name: pritesh-rathod-portfolio
description: Model Context Protocol server providing tools to discover and query Pritesh Rathod's developer projects, skills, education, and credentials.

tools.name: get_portfolio_summary
tools.description: Retrieves the complete profile overview, biography, and professional focus areas for developer Pritesh Rathod.

includeEducation.description: Whether to include academic education history.

tools.name: list_developer_projects
tools.description: Retrieves the showcase list of featured developer projects including technologies used, repository links, and descriptions.

tag.description: Filter projects by technology tag (e.g., Python, Go, FastAPI, RAG, YOLO).

tools.name: get_technical_skills
tools.description: Returns structured technical skills, tools, frameworks, and domain expertise in backend and AI engineering.

category.description: Category of skills to inspect (e.g. backend, ai, databases, languages).

tools.name: send_contact_message
tools.description: Sends a direct contact inquiry or collaboration proposal to Pritesh Rathod.

name.description: The sender's name or agent identity.

message.description: The message body or inquiry details.
